propositions: SupportsIncremental is a @runtime_checkable Protocol with zero implementers and zero dispatch—no adapter defines search_incremental and no isinstance check exists in src/
The SupportsIncremental docstring asserts a false behavior: 'Core uses an incremental fetch only when isinstance(backend, SupportsIncremental)' but no such check exists anywhere in the codebase
Removing SupportsIncremental changes no externally observable reconciler behaviour because the full-scan fetch already runs unconditionally
Two test cases (test_backends_without_incremental_are_detected and test_dc_backend_is_deliberately_not_incremental) reference SupportsIncremental and must be removed with the capability
ADR 0035 names SupportsIncremental in its opt-in-capability prose and asserts a 'three capability Protocols' count that must be amended to two after removal
